verdict.rationale: Docusign's official GitHub repository docusign/OpenAPI-Specifications publishes OpenAPI/Swagger files, which Docusign uses to generate its client SDKs. That gives users a first-party, machine-readable spec they can download. The probe 404s show only that the spec is not served at conventional paths on developers.docusign.com; they do not contradict the GitHub-hosted spec. Missing for 10: discoverable spec at a standard well-known URL on the developer site, evidence of which Docusign APIs and versions the spec covers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
